"What's Love Got to Do With It" tells the harrowing story of Tina Turner's life and music, and her relationship with Ike Turner. The movie unflinchingly depicts the violence and abuse that Tina endured, and her struggles to break free and find success on her own. Despite the hardships she faced, Tina eventually found the strength to stand up to Ike, encapsulated in a powerful scene towards the end of the movie when Ike slips past security into Tina's dressing room with a gun, and Tina finds the inner strength to face him down. The movie stars Angela Bassett as Tina and Laurence Fishburne as Ike, and features a soundtrack of Tina Turner's songs performed by Bassett. "What's Love Got to Do With It" has a lot of great music in it, but ultimately it is a story of pain and courage, uncompromisingly portraying Tina Turner's resilience in the face of adversity, and showcasing her incredible talent.

In the TV show Breaking Bad, Walter, one of the protagonists is in a business partnership with Gus. But things take a turn when Walter saves his other business partner Jesse’s life from two drug dealers. This made Gus mad and he threatened to kill Walter, Jesse, Walter’s wife Skyler, Walter’s son Walter Junior, and Walter’s granddaughter Holly. So, Gus just threatened to kill everyone Walter cared about. 

Now, Jesse who is now working with Gus made things much worse by taking Gus’ side and not helping Walter. This made this really bad because Jesse sided with Gus who kills children and Walter did not like that obviously. So, Walter then had no choice but to find a way to get Jesse back on his side to take Gus down. Walter then gave Gus’ little son Brock some bad food which made him sick. Walter does this so he can get Jesse back on his side and so Jesse can help him kill Gus.
